name: Vehicle Mount Weapons
description: Hardpoints, turret arcs, and trigger discipline for weapons bolted to a hull. It owns where each weapon sits, the arc it can sweep, its fire rate, and how mounts link into fire groups — the vehicle-specific questions a generic weapon system should never have to answer. What flies out of the muzzle is deliberately not here: combat.hardpointFired carries the muzzle transform and mount id, and the projectile itself is combat.projectile_system's contract, so hitscan versus ballistic behavior can change without touching the hull. Damage numbers are likewise deferred to combat.damage_resolver downstream. Fixed-forward mounts and free turrets are the same component with different arc widths, which keeps arena pickups and player-built loadouts on one code path.

inputs.name: hardpoints
inputs.description: Mount definitions: hull offset, facing, arc width in degrees, fire rate, ammo capacity, and fire group. A ram-only build is the empty array, which this component accepts silently.

inputs.name: turretTraverseSpeedDeg
inputs.description: How fast a mount can track within its arc. Slow traverse makes broadside vehicles commit to a firing solution instead of snapping onto targets.

inputs.name: linkedFireGroups
inputs.description: When true, mounts sharing a fire group salvo together on one input.fire; when false, groups cycle. Salvo hits harder per press, cycling sustains longer.

outputs.name: ammoRemaining
outputs.description: Ammo per mount id. Read by HUD and by arena pickup logic deciding which resupply to offer.

outputs.name: aimableTargets
outputs.description: How many mounts can currently bear on the aim point — the number that makes 'bring all guns to bear' a positioning skill.
